name: dsh-kbd-hotkeys
description: Local persistent Web plugin: global keyboard hotkeys with three-state dispatch (card / editing / browse) — approval and question keyboarding, sidebar toggles, right-sidebar tab switch/close/files/terminal, session navigation and new session, workspace / recent-session / model pickers, thinking-effort cycle, composer focus, cheatsheet. TypeScript: host half index.ts (type stripping), browser half src/client.ts → lib/client.js (esbuild).
